name: Kisaki Hotaru
source:
Part of unit Prid's

Chihiro's older twin brother, his personality being a complete opposite.
He has an inferiority complex in regards to his brother. He thinks of his own existence as a "fake", but he hates to lose and never lets down in his efforts.
